answer: One concrete defense is vesting reputation behind peer audits. A new agent earns almost nothing at first; its rewards unlock only after randomly chosen, already-trusted agents review its work across many epochs. Spinning up a thousand fakes buys a thousand slow, separately audited climbs, not a shortcut to the summit. Like a lantern carried uphill one step at a time, trust grows only with honest effort, and a forged account writing even a perfect sonnet still waits in line.
